name: invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select i.id, (i.number || ' ' || c.name) as name from invoices i join customers c on c.id = i.customer_id where i.status <> 'paid' order by i.issued_on desc

sections.title: Invoice
sections.note: Rendered from the meter. Check it, then send it yourself: this system never sends anything.
sections.sql: select i.number, c.name as billed_to, h.ref as hire, h.site, coalesce(h.po_number, '') as order_no, to_char(i.issued_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as issued, to_char(i.due_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as due, to_char(i.total_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990.00') as total from invoices i join customers c on c.id = i.customer_id join hires h on h.id = i.hire_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Lines
sections.sql: select il.description, to_char(il.amount_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990.00') as amount from invoice_lines il where il.invoice_id = $1 order by il.created_at

name: hire-agreement-draft
title: Hire agreement (draft)
for_each: select h.id, (h.ref || ' ' || c.name) as name from hires h join customers c on c.id = h.customer_id where h.status in ('booked', 'live') and h.contract_signed_on is null order by h.start_on

sections.title: This is a draft. Nobody has signed anything.
sections.note: The agreement carries the contract's own machines, rates and dates. Put it on your letterhead, attach your terms, sign it at the counter or the gate. A consumer customer keeps the Consumer Guarantees Act 1993 no matter what the terms say (s 43).
sections.sql: select c.name as hirer, coalesce(c.contact_name, '') as contact, h.ref as our_reference, h.site as site_address, to_char(h.start_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as hire_from, coalesce(to_char(h.expected_end_on, 'DD Month YYYY'), 'open-ended, until off-hired') as expected_end, coalesce(h.po_number, '') as order_no, c.account_type from hires h join customers c on c.id = h.customer_id where h.id = $1

sections.title: The gear and the rates
sections.sql: select a.code, a.description as machine, coalesce(a.serial, '') as serial, to_char(hl.day_rate_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,990.00') as per_day, to_char(hl.week_rate_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,990.00') as per_week from hire_lines hl join assets a on a.id = hl.asset_id where hl.hire_id = $1 order by a.code

sections.title: How charging works
sections.sql: select 'Charging runs per calendar day from the day the gear leaves the yard. The day it comes back is not charged; a same-day return charges one day. Every run of seven days is capped at the week rate.' as terms, 'Off-hire happens when you tell us, not when you finish with the machine. Ring it off the moment you are done.' as off_hire, 'Damage found at the return check is reported with photos, then charged or waived in writing.' as damage where exists (select 1 from hires where id = $1)

name: off-hire-docket
title: Off-hire docket
for_each: select hl.id, (h.ref || ' ' || a.code) as name from hire_lines hl join hires h on h.id = hl.hire_id join assets a on a.id = hl.asset_id where hl.off_hired_on is not null and hl.off_hired_on >= current_date - 30 order by hl.off_hired_on desc

sections.title: Return record
sections.note: One docket per machine off hire in the last 30 days: the dates, the days charged, and what the return check found.
sections.sql: select h.ref as hire, c.name as customer, h.site, a.code, a.description as machine, to_char(hl.on_hired_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as out, to_char(hl.off_hired_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as off_hire, coalesce(to_char(hl.picked_up_on, 'DD Month YYYY'), 'NOT YET PICKED UP') as back_in_yard, lc.total_days as days_charged from hire_lines hl join hires h on h.id = hl.hire_id join customers c on c.id = h.customer_id join assets a on a.id = hl.asset_id join v_line_charge lc on lc.line_id = hl.id where hl.id = $1

sections.title: Damage found at the return check
sections.sql: select to_char(dr.reported_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as reported, dr.description, case when dr.est_cost_cents is not null then to_char(dr.est_cost_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990.00') else '' end as estimate, dr.status, coalesce(dr.waived_reason, '') as note from damage_reports dr where dr.hire_line_id = $1 order by dr.reported_on

name: workshop-job-card
title: Workshop job card
for_each: select s.id, (a.code || ' ' || s.kind) as name from services s join assets a on a.id = s.asset_id where s.status <> 'done' order by s.opened_on

sections.title: The job
sections.sql: select a.code, a.description as machine, coalesce(a.make, '') as make, coalesce(a.model, '') as model, coalesce(a.serial, '') as serial, case when a.meter_hours is not null then a.meter_hours || 'h' else '' end as meter, s.kind as job, s.status, to_char(s.opened_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as opened, coalesce(to_char(s.due_on, 'DD Month YYYY'), '') as due, coalesce(st.full_name, '') as mechanic, coalesce(s.note, '') as note from services s join assets a on a.id = s.asset_id left join staff st on st.id = s.mechanic_id where s.id = $1

sections.title: Service history on this machine
sections.sql: select to_char(s2.done_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as done, s2.kind, case when s2.cost_cents is not null then to_char(s2.cost_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,990.00') else '' end as cost, coalesce(s2.note, '') as note from services s2 where s2.asset_id = (select asset_id from services where id = $1) and s2.status = 'done' order by s2.done_on desc limit 10
